lines.trans: The most unpleasant situation is in our restaurant.
Right now we are practically operating at a loss.
Oh, here they have brought my lunch!
I asked you a very important question.
Why did such a situation arise for us?
Auteur cuisine costs us very dearly.
Guests are unhappy with the small size of the dishes.

What sensible proposals do you have?
We can cut our expenses a little.
Let us bring back the good old menu.
Then people will flock back to us again.
